title: Design a 3D Binary Matrix with Efficient Layer Tracking
summary: Implement Matrix3D(n), initially all zero, with setCell(x,y,z), unsetCell(x,y,z), and largestMatrix(). The query returns the x-layer with the most ones, choosing the largest x on a tie. Repeated sets or unsets must not double-count a cell.
